directory_input.instructions: Does the Founder give an instruction, a decision, a preference or a rejection about Lumina's public hotel directory pages (their design, content, sections, photos, videos, icons, SEO, indexing, page titles, share images or branding)?

criteria.true: The Founder gives an instruction, a decision, a preference or a rejection about Lumina's public hotel directory pages
criteria.false: The Founder gives no instruction, decision, preference or rejection about Lumina's public hotel directory pages

indexing_and_meta.what: Search engine indexing (index or noindex, sitemap), page titles, meta descriptions, canonical or language versions

share_images_and_branding.what: The preview shown when a page link is shared (WhatsApp, LinkedIn, X, Facebook), the share image, the favicon or the Lumina branding on the pages

hero_and_layout.what: The hero at the top of the page, the navigation bar, the page grid or the overall layout

icons.what: Icons, emoji or the icon library

personalisation.what: Personalising the page to the reader, for example choosing a type of traveller that changes the text

sections_and_copy.what: A content section of a hotel page or its wording: what to expect, rooms, surroundings, a day at the hotel, the Lumina verdict, things to know, what emerges

photos.what: Photos on the pages: their choice, style, composition, retouching or generation

map.what: The map on the page: its style, filters or points

videos.what: Videos on the page, a video library, YouTube or social videos of the hotel

reviews.what: Guest reviews, ratings or review-site logos

faq_and_index.what: Frequently asked questions or the table of contents at the side of the page

footer.what: The footer or the list of sources at the bottom of the page

keyword_pages.what: The pages built around a Google search (hotel plus moment), or the demo made by Lumina inside them

other_directory.what: Something else about the hotel directory pages or the directory home

not_directory.what: Not about the hotel directory pages
